raw.query: WITH current_dim AS (SELECT * FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = true AND superseded_by IS NULL), pairs(policy, live_run, sim_run) AS (VALUES ('forecast'::text, 'live:arm:live_fc'::text, 'live:twin_fc_p90_cap4'::text), ('reactive'::text, 'live:arm:live_re'::text, 'live:twin_re_cap4'::text)) SELECT p.policy, la.ttft_p99_ms AS live_ttft_p99_ms, si.achieved_p99_ms AS simulated_ttft_p99_ms, (la.ttft_p99_ms <= si.bound_ms) AS live_passes_sla, (NOT si.is_violation) AS simulation_passes_sla, ROUND((100 * ABS(la.ttft_p99_ms - si.achieved_p99_ms) / si.achieved_p99_ms)::numeric, 3) AS p99_difference_pct, la.replica_seconds AS live_replica_seconds, pc.provisioned_worker_seconds AS simulated_replica_seconds, ROUND((100 * ABS(la.replica_seconds - pc.provisioned_worker_seconds) / pc.provisioned_worker_seconds)::numeric, 3) AS replica_time_difference_pct FROM pairs p JOIN current_dim dl ON dl.run_id = p.live_run JOIN current_dim ds ON ds.run_id = p.sim_run JOIN provenance.v_live_anchor la ON la.policy = p.policy JOIN provenance.v_infraction si ON si.run_id = p.sim_run AND si.is_current = true AND si.sla_metric = 'ttft' JOIN provenance.v_pool_cost pc ON pc.run_id = p.sim_run AND pc.is_current = true ORDER BY p.policy
raw.claimed: Forecast policy passes live exactly as simulated; reactive policy fails likewise, its p99 within 1.1% of simulation; provisioned replica-time agrees within 8%.
raw.evidence: Both verdict directions match; reactive TTFT p99 matches within 1.051% (under the 1.1% bound); both replica-time differences (5.264% and 7.641%) are within the 8% bound.
